messages.author: e462f69252f08a3d
messages.subject: ERROR
parts:
Hello everyone.

I'm trying to fit in linux the following model

Ajuste <- function(formula, data){

       fit.sp <- inla(formula=formula, data=data, Ntrials =1, family="binomial", control.inla = list(strategy = "laplace", int.strategy = "grid", fast=FALSE) , verbose = TRUE,control.compute = list(dic=TRUE, waic=T),

                      control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE))

       summary(fit.sp)

       return(fit.sp)}


I giving the following error:


Loading required package: Matrix
Loading required package: sp
Loading required package: parallel
Loading required package: foreach
This is INLA_20.03.17 built 2020-06-19 17:42:18 UTC.
See www.r-inla.org/contact-us for how to get help.
To enable PARDISO sparse library; see inla.pardiso()
/cephfs/scratch/7107227/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.5/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /lib64/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.23' not found (required by /cephfs/scratch/7107227/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.5/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla)
/cephfs/scratch/7107227/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.5/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /lib64/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.23' not found (required by /cephfs/scratch/7107227/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.5/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/libRmath.so.1)
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
Calls: Ajuste -> inla -> inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed
In addition: Warning message:
In inla.model.properties.generic(inla.trim.family(model), mm[names(mm) ==  :
  Model 'sn' in section 'link' is marked as 'experimental'; changes may appear at any time.
  Use this model with extra care!!! Further warnings are disabled.
Execution halted


Does anyone out there have any idea how to solve? On windows it works perfectly.


Thank you

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] ERROR
parts:
hi & thank for your email.

I would recommend to upgrade to R-3.6

your linux distrubution does not match with the precompiled binary
(Ubuntu1804), so you can try to download another one instead. You may
start with CentOS7, and try that first.
